news.title: Various NPC Fixes and Deathstalker Erland Spawn Rate - WoW: Forever Hotfixes
news.description: The first set of hotfixes are out for WoW: Forever, which fixes issues with various NPCs and spawns Deathstalker Erland faster for his quest!
news.details:
The 3rd Druid Trainer on Zephras Isle now offers training as intended.
Trade supply vendors now sell apprentice tradeskill bags.
Plainsrunning no longer stacks in the battleground prep phase.
Plainsrunning no longer works while carrying a flag.
Deathstalker Erland for Escorting Erland spawns much more frequently.
Yarrog Baneshadow for the quest item Burning Blade Medallion now spawns more frequently.
Here you will find a list of hotfixes that address various issues related to World of Warcraft: Forever.
This list will be updated as additional hotfixes are applied.

news.title: Minimum Deposit of 1 Silver Required to List Items on Auction House in WoW: Forever
news.description: In WoW: Forever, listing an item on the Auction House always incurs a deposit of at least 1 silver.
news.details:
When players list an item on the Auction House, a deposit is required. The deposit is given back to players if the item successfully sells, but is lost if the item is cancelled or the Auction expires. In the original version of WoW, the deposit requirement depends on the item's Vendor Price and the duration:
DurationDeposit Cost
2 Hours5% of Vendor Price
8 Hours20% of Vendor Price
24 Hours60% of Vendor Price
Vendor Price of 4 Silver and 61 Copper
In WoW: Forever, there appears to be one more rule: A minimum of 1 Silver is required.
With a Vendor price of 4 Silver and 61 Copper, we would expect an 8-hour listing of this item to require 92 Copper, but this is listed at 1 Silver. Similarly, if you take any cheap vendor item, the Deposit is always listed as 1 Silver. This increased deposit imposes a significant risk to players if the item doesn't sell within the time frame. news.title: Blizzard Investigating Issues with Certain Escort Quests in WoW: Forever
news.description: Blizzard is investigating issues with certain quests in WoW: Forever.
news.details:
BlizzardCS has started writing comments on Wowhead quest pages, noting that certain quests are bugged and that they're investigating the issue.
Escort Quests
BlizzardCS has commented on the quest pages of Freedom to Ruul, Free From the Hold, and The Defias Brotherhood. These are all escort quests that can immediately fail if the quest giver dies or, in this case, despawns.
Blizzard
We're aware that Ruul/Gilthares Firebough/Defias Traitor may disappear when moving near or across zone and area boundaries, causing the quest to fail. We're already investigating the issue.
Undead Paladin Quest
One of the early Undead Paladin quests is Rediscovering the Light, which requires players to rediscover how to use Holy Light. Sometimes healing the NPCs doesn't give progress towards the quest objective and Blizzard is aware of the issue.

news.title: New Prerequisites Required for Ruins of Lordaeron Dungeon Quests in WoW: Forever
news.description: Two Horde quests for Ruins of Lordaeron have new prerequisite quests on live servers!
news.details:
Ruins of Lordaeron DungeonAll Dungeon Quests
Dungeon quests are a very good source of experience in WoW: Forever, as the experience from killing dungeon mobs was nerfed and the amount of experience from dungeon quests were buffed. Ruins of Lordaeron is the second dungeon Horde players are likely to run and when collecting the Dungeon quests, there's a change on the live servers: two of the Horde quests now have a quest chain prerequisite in order to pick them up.
While Alliance players don't have any prerequisites to pick up their quests, The Wrath of Rath'mael and The New Plague now both require a quest chain to be completed when they were previously available right away on Beta.

news.title: How to Phase to See Group Members After Joining New Group
news.description: When you join a new group in WoW: Forever, you'll have to manually trigger a phase transition to see your group members.
news.details:
Blizzard made a change after the WoW: Forever Beta and announced it on their podcast. When you join a group in WoW: Forever, you don't automatically phase to the same layer as them. Instead, players will have to click an arrow on the top left of their chat window to manually trigger the phase.
This can be useful when you're out in the world and don't want to trigger a phase change immediately! This popup will occur even if you're in Town doing nothing, so if you don't see your group, make sure to check for this arrow!

news.title: McDonald's Canada Offering WoW Game Time for Reward Points
news.description: McDonald's Canada is offering new WoW reward redemptions on their app until November 23rd.
news.details:
The McDonald's x Xbox crossover continues and is now available in Canada! Previously available in Ireland and the UK, and then Australia, Canadians can now redeem their McDonalds' rewards points for WoW items.
All redemptions cost 2,000 Rewards Points and will be available until November 23rd.
14 Days of Game Time
Red Hot Portable Bakery
Lil' Ragnaros
This is the third time that Red Hot Portable Bakery has become available, each time in a different region. From previous promotions, the redemption code is not region-specific. This means that you can get a friend to give you their code. If you're not interested in each of the collection items from Retail, you may want to grab the Game Time, which will work for all versions of the game, including Forever!

news.title: Earn 700 Discord Orbs with New WoW: Forever Quest
news.description: Play WoW: Forever for 15 minutes and earn 700 Discord Orbs!
news.details:
A new Discord Quest asks players to play WoW: Forever for 15 minutes to earn 700 Discord Orbs (840 with Nitro). You can find this quest by going to Direct Messages > Quests > World of Warcraft Play Quest.
Once you accept the quest, play the game for 15 minutes and then claim your Orbs! Discord Orbs can be used to purchase cosmetics from the Discord shop.
